steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That person is still alive... Chief, you did it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Take some rest. You've just overused your Shackle of power during the fight, your body is almost out of strength.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Take some rest. I'll go and bring back Zoya with you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief? Where are you going?
You walk toward Zoya. Your brain feels heavy but your steps feel light and weak. You feel like falling with each step, but still you make your way to her clumsily.
Zoya is unconscious. The spikes on her body have not disappeared. She's standing with her head dropped low, looking like a prisoner awaiting execution or the tombstone of a dead person.

You tug at the shackles and feel nothing but filthy contamination on the other end. <color=#fb9259>That thing</color> is still there. Its weakness has triggered its survival instinct, causing it to drill deeper into Zoya's soul.

options: Wake up! Think of what you should be doing!

steps.content: You take out all the Hyperpyramids given to you by 036. Like he did, you press your hands on Zoya's temples and hold her head, ordering and pleading.
All the pyramids are being consumed rapidly. The blue crystals dim and shatter quickly, slipping through your hands like sand. Your consciousness soon starts blurring as well.

options: Don't let it lead you away. That's not you

steps.content: Her head is still bowed low, but a contorted hand suddenly raises to strangle your throat.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>It's mine... It's mine...!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare! Ahhh...!!

Hecate doesn't have enough strength left to summon the Nightmare. Because of Zoya, the shackles have become extremely heavy, pressing down on everyone linked to you. Their faces all look absolutely agonized.
Killing Zoya is the only course of action that can stop this catastrophe.
There's a <color=#fb9259>gun</color> in your pocket.
Stop... the Black Ring... Must stop it...
At this distance, even you won't miss.
As if sensing your thought, the surrounding contamination swarm toward your hands. But several blue bullets fly from behind you at the same time, crushing the filth.
${PlayerName}!!
${PlayerName}, do it.
Only you can do it!

From the corner of your eye, you see that Hella is lying unconscious on the ground, Hecate has lost her Nightmare, and 036 is leaning on the wall, covering you with his last bit of strength. Out of bullets, his eyes are almost imploring.
You don't know what the Black Ring is, but you know full well that if it's not stopped, it will crush everyone here.
The force strangling you is becoming stronger. This is a life or death battle between you and that presence. Your hands are finally moving, and your choice is...
You pull out the gun and press it to Zoya's forehead. She lifts her eyes slightly. Time stops at this moment.
You see that last sparkle of light go out. It's become a stranger's eye, full of insanity, fear, hatred, and greed —that hideous thing has taken her over.
...At least I can't let you destroy her heart.
Boom—

A strong blast hits you. She releases her hand, and you get blown to one side, seeing stars. That's not the bullet you shot, but something more powerful and aggressive —<color=#fb9259>a micro-bomb</color>.
You lie down still. Familiar metallic footsteps sound on the cold floor. Someone you know walks into the hall.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Don't touch her.
You...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: F**k off!
036 wants to stop him, but the other man dodges his severely injured body effortlessly and pushes him onto the floor.
Earl's quite badly wounded as well, but compared to the others here, he has the best mobility.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The Legion's commander is not going to die here. Not in your hands.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...You're not worthy enough.
He kicks away your gun with his metallic prosthetic and steps over your immobile body without glancing back, making his way to Zoya.
Not pulling out the gun, you cover her forehead with your hand.
With your power, you could have broken my neck easily. But I'm still alive.
You're here, right, Zoya? Answer me, come back with me.
Stop, you won't be able to stand it! Don't..
You activate the shackles.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!

steps.speaker: Zoya??
steps.content: Let her go, let her go! She's mine! I'm gonna kill you, I'm gonna kill you!

The force strangling your neck suddenly strengthens. Your consciousness begins to blur and you can't hear the shouts of others. The shrill loud voices are fading and you can only hold on tight to one thought—<color=#fb9259>you can't let go</color>.
Bang! Bang, bang, bang!
A series of bullets hit the hand strangling you. The arm explodes and breaks off like black gel. Your body gives out and falls back, and your hand moves away from Zoya's body.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!

Perhaps the hope of survival has granted her power. The torn Nightmare is summoned, and before contamination gathers to form an arm again, the Nightmare wraps itself around you and drags you away from danger.
You lie down still. Familiar metallic footsteps sound on the cold floor. Someone you know walks into the hall.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...You are more stubborn than I imagined.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Your shackles have already failed. Stop trying to get yourself killed for nothing.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: It's not yet time for you to act...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...I'll leave Commander to you.
This is his last words to you. The man then steps over you and makes his way to Zoya, to that single bloody eye.
Contamination spills out again, wrapping around his wounded body from the bottom up, only to be met with a sneer from the Legion advisor.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: What a sight, you're so badly injured by that one there... In this condition, you can't descend anymore even if you completely suck the lifeblood of the Commander, can you?

steps.speaker: Zoya??
steps.content: Arghhhhhhhh! Give it to me... give it to me!!
He presses firmly on the scar on her body left by the intruding bloody flesh.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Leave her alone. I'll help you, take my bones and blood, my soul, my everything. Come to me!

steps.speaker: Zoya??
steps.content: You're not worthy enough, you're not, you...?!
A strange white light leaks out from Earl's hand. The light seems surprisingly familiar.

steps.speaker: Zoya??
steps.content: Ahhh...! It's her! It's her!! Hahahaha, give it to me, give it to me!!
Its power suddenly surges. Sharp black spikes pierce through Earl's body and coil themselves around him like tentacles, dragging him near Zoya.
Stop! Stay away from her. Sinners shouldn't get close to her, or the Black Ring will destroy everything here!

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Haha... So what? This place is not worth her life.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Come on, the DisCity. Reckoning time has come. Embrace the Black Ring...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: This is what you get from the vile seed you've planted in Syndicate. You deserve it.
The filth growls as it swallows the two and fuses them into one. The spikes shatter the ground and overturn the ceiling. A murky purple light erupts and obliterates everything before your eyes.
The moment you see the luminous red ring, countless dark shadows cling onto your consciousness and drag it into an abyss.
The job is done. We should go before the troublesome spiders crawl here.
